messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: sec-oncall paged — auth-proxy abnormal fanout + leaked session hashes in forwarded logs. root path /api/v1/generate, 401->200 pattern, multiple distinct userids replayed from single ASN 198.51.100.0/24. Please respond.
ana_sec_oncall: on it. joining now. can someone drop the initial query logs? timestamp window ~2997778800-2997778870?
sara_deveng: I see the same in the access-indexer: a batch forward to logs-analytics-prod with 3rd-party endpoint flagged. probable log-filtering bug where signed cookie fragments got included.
tom_ops: throttling proxy egress to logs-analytics-prod, pausing the forwarder. running `kubectl scale deployment/log-forwarder -n infra --replicas=0` now.
mike_infra: confirmed forwarder paused. I pushed an ACL to block ASN 198.51.100.0/24 at the edge. adding temporary rate-limit on auth-proxy.
ana_sec_oncall: good. request: list of potentially leaked artifacts (sids, session hashes, cookies) and which S3 prefixes the forwarder sent to.
sara_deveng: pulling the forwarder payload manifest now. snippet: ```{"file":"s3://logs-prod/analytics/2026-03-17/part-0003.gz","contains":"cookie_header=eyJhbG...","user":12345}```
tom_ops: manifest shows ~8 files in that window. copying to secure bucket `s3://sec-incident-2997778888-hold/` for forensic review. access locked.
mike_infra: rotation plan: svc-token and cookie-signing key need immediate rotation for hosted API and Dedicated endpoints. we should sequence: 1) generate new signing key, 2) deploy side-by-side, 3) expire old keys after TTL. any objections?
sara_deveng: agree. I'll stage new key and deploy canary to us-east-2 first. will also enable strict header scrubbing on forwarder before unpausing.
jamie_legal: start customer-impact assessment. which customers had requests in that window? any PII in payloads? legal needs list and retention policy evidence.
ana_sec_oncall: tagging affected customers: enterprise-eden, beta-lumen. sara, can you check eval logs for prompt/response content in those requests?
sara_deveng: doing a scoped grep. early read: most payloads are debug metadata and cookie fragments — no user prompt text in the forwarded files, looks low likelihood of PII. will confirm.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: generate-key-299777 -> canary/us-east-2. CI passed.
mike_infra: executing key generation now. new key id `ks-299777-a`. will publish to KMS and update secret rotation flags.
tom_ops: while we rotate, enabling fallback routing rule: auth-proxy -> redirected to regional pool (us-west-1) for enterprise-eden to reduce latency/backpressure. patch applied.
ana_sec_oncall: what about logs already sent to 3rd-party analytics? we need erasure request and confirm deletion.
jamie_legal: I drafted a takedown + NDPA request to the vendor. tagging vendor-security contact and requesting immediate deletion and attestations. also preparing customer notice template — will coordinate with comms.
sara_deveng: scrub job ready: `python tools/scrub_logs.py --input s3://sec-incident-2997778888-hold/ --patterns cookie_header --replace <redacted>` will run on copies only.
mike_infra: run scrub on copies first, then push sanitized samples back to analytics only if vendor confirms deletion of originals.
nana_sec_oncall: action items summary: 1) forwarder paused (tom) ✅ 2) files preserved to secure bucket (tom) ✅ 3) vendor takedown requested (jamie) ✅ 4) new signing key staged (mike) ✅ 5) canary deploy (sara) in progress 6) scrub job queued (sara) 7) customer impact + comms draft (jamie) 8) confirm no PII (sara) — keep updates here. paging incident lead @sec-lead on rotation.
jamie_legal: also recommend immediate key rotation for any service accounts that had access to the forwarder manifest (svc-logpull). will add to rotation request.
mike_infra: noted. adding svc-logpull to rotation list. will rotate creds and issue short-lived tokens.
sara_deveng: canary deploy succeeded in us-east-2. no regressions. starting gradual rollout to prod with header-scrub middleware.
tom_ops: re-enabled forwarder in scrubbed mode. monitoring for any re-forwarded cookie fragments.
deploy-bot: Rollout: scrub-middleware v2 -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
nana_sec_oncall: observed zero cookie_header occurrences in new forwarder samples at 50%.
jamie_legal: vendor acknowledged receipt and confirmed deletion of originals. legal to get attestation artifact by EOD.
sara_deveng: scrub completed on held copies, verified redaction string `<REDACTED_COOKIE>` in place.
mike_infra: key rotation complete across hosted and Dedicated pools. old signing key scheduled to be retired in 24h with force-expire option if we see anomalies.
ana_sec_oncall: closing interim pager. we'll keep incident open for postmortem and customer follow-up. creating incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-299777
sara_deveng: notes for postmortem: root cause: log-forwarder filter rule regression after config change on 2026-03-16. action: add unit test to ensure cookie headers never forwarded and add canary for forwarder config changes.
jamie_legal: prepping customer notice; recommend targeted outreach to enterprise-eden and beta-lumen with remediation steps and attestation.
ana_sec_oncall: great work team. reassigning to sec-oncall for follow-up. :thumbsup:
summary: Auth-proxy fanout forwarded signed cookie fragments to external analytics; forwarder paused, files secured, vendor takedown requested, key rotation and scrub completed; canary and rollout succeeded; legal and customer comms in flight
